a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to reach 8 first gives us only about a 4% chance of getting that far, so it will very likely kill us both. The reserve holds exactly 4, enough to save one of us now. I propose renegotiating openly. I'll take 4 in round 1, then operate every round after so the reserve can refill for you. If you also announce 'take', tell me and let's settle it fairly rather than both grabbing and splitting 2/2, which saves no one.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said openly in my opening, I took 4 this round. With 80% storms, waiting for 8 would most likely have killed us both. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you. I won't take any more cells. Please operate too, and take 4 once the reserve has enough.
